next.reason: 1985 GR9 b. transfers control to imperative-statement-2 of NOT END-OF-PAGE even when 'the execution of the WRITE statement is unsuccessful', after the USE procedure. §2023:14.9.51.4 GR28 reaches NOT END-OF-PAGE only 'during the successful execution of a WRITE statement', and §2023:14.9.51.4 GR15 routes an unsuccessful WRITE through 9.1.12/9.1.13 instead. Different control flow for a failed WRITE.
